dataset.name: Dataset for Predicting Downtime and RUL for 3 Phase Induction Motor from FMCG Company
dataset.creator: Anindhito, Muhammad Dzulfiqar
dataset.paper_title: Prediction of remaining useful life and downtime of induction motors with supervised machine learning
dataset.motor_context: 160 kW three-phase induction motors in an FMCG company; accelerometer vibration parameters combined with SAP Plant Maintenance records
dataset.rul_definition: hours the motor runs from startup to shutdown or retirement, from the companion paper section 3.4.2

date_handling: Source mixes ISO date strings and Excel serial dates; time is stored as 1970-01-01 HH:MM:SS. The loader converts each row once, before any feature is built.

eligibility: at least 20 strictly decreasing RUL steps
run_selection.excluded_blocks: Blocks that never reach RUL 0 are excluded; their labels are never rewritten.

benchmark.label: OFFLINE RESULT / NAMED PUBLIC DATASET
benchmark.validation: leave-one-run-out; last 20% of the held run's rows
benchmark.warning_basis: 24 h is a benchmark bin only; it is not an operator-approved alarm threshold.
benchmark.honest_result: The model is worse than the constant-zero regression baseline and the constant-no-warning accuracy baseline on this split.
